name: 4-HO-MBT
summary: 4-HO-MBT, also known as 4-hydroxy-N-methyl-N-butyltryptamine, is a chemical compound of the tryptamine and 4-hydroxytryptamine families related to the psychedelic drug psilocin (4-HO-DMT).

uses.text: 4-HO-MBT was briefly described by Alexander Shulgin in his book TiHKAL (Tryptamines I Have Known and Loved), but was not tested by him and its properties and effects are unknown.

fact.en: Alexander Shulgin listed it in his book TiHKAL, but he never tested it himself, so its effects remain unknown. It carries a four-carbon butyl chain where psilocin has a methyl group.
fact.zh: Alexander Shulgin在著作《TiHKAL》中列出了它，但他本人從未測試過，因此它的作用至今不明。在脫磷酸裸蓋菇素帶有甲基的位置上，它接的是四個碳的丁基鏈。
fact.zhHans: Alexander Shulgin在著作《TiHKAL》中列出了它，但他本人从未测试过，因此它的作用至今不明。在脱磷酸裸盖菇素带有甲基的位置上，它接的是四个碳的丁基链。
